method: Pre-first-result or closure; time-weighted active unit snapshots; no code changes. See accompanying report for denominators and limitations.

metric_notes.peak_stress: Maximum observed in periodic snapshots or applied-fire effects; does not guarantee detection of transient unsampled generic-event peaks.
metric_notes.max_pin_run: Approximate longest consecutive pinned interval measured from periodic snapshots.
metric_notes.raw_composition_delta_including_caps: Raw composed stress minus baseline suppression and casualty shock; includes composition caps and can be negative. Not an isolated directional bonus.
